Detailed Implementation
4.1
Document Processing Pipeline
When a user uploads a document, the application must extract raw text regardless of the
original file format. The implementation handles this robustly:
1. Parsing Phase:
• PDFs: The PyMuPDF (fitz) library is utilized.
It provides highly accurate text
extraction, bounding box alignment, and handles multi-column layouts better than
standard alternatives like PyPDF2.
• DOCX: The python-docx library iterates through paragraphs and tables to yield
continuous string data.
• TXT: Read via standard UTF-8 decoding, with fallback encodings to prevent
UnicodeDecodeError exceptions.
2. Chunking Strategy: Extracted text is split using a Recursive Character Text
Splitter. This algorithmic approach attempts to split text on logical boundaries (double
newlines, single newlines, periods, spaces) to ensure that a chunk contains a complete
semantic thought.

Listing 2: Text Chunking Configuration
A chunk size of 1000 characters with an overlap of 200 characters prevents sentence
fragmentation. The overlap ensures that a sentence split directly across a chunk boundary
is still captured by the embedding model in at least one of the chunks.
